title: Figure 25. AFM Scan of DNA walkers carrying gold-atom cargo along a track
description: Three false-color atomic force microscopy images on a yellow-green background showing a dark blue linear track with magenta blobs representing walkers carrying cargo, each with a black scale bar. Captioned "Figure 25. AFM Scan of walkers as they follow a track pattern places on the surface. Each can take up to 50 steps... Scale bar is 50 nm. (129)" Text below introduces "The Nano Walker; a Spider-like Approach."
